name: Stable Mint USD
oneLiner: USDSM is Stable mint Ltd's dollar token, backed by cash and liquid financial assets and redeemable at par after holder onboarding.
collateral: Issuer-disclosed U.S. dollar cash deposits and high-quality liquid financial assets; current banks, asset weights and independently reconciled backing are undisclosed
pegMechanism: Legal-person participants mint against received USD deposits; legal and natural holders can request par USD redemption after issuer acceptance and AML/KYC onboarding, including Redemption-Only Clients. Terms sections 9.1 and 9.4 impose no redemption minimum or issuer redemption fee, but third-party bank/intermediary charges may apply. Payment is without undue delay after token receipt and screening; private-platform indicative processing periods do not establish a final-bank-receipt SLA. Etherlink is the primary deployment, with LayerZero V2 burn-and-mint interoperability across Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Issuer terms define a fixed-par USD electronic-money claim backed by fiat deposits and liquid financial assets, without holder NAV appreciation or borrower collateral positions. This supports fiat-cash classification without claiming itemized current reserves. Current native implementation 0x7089856110b005a40e8d16da1da31313b0f60561 was activated July 22, 2025 in the pinned proxy upgrade event.

sources.label: Fixed-par fiat backing and issuance/redemption terms
